annotations.title: Make an offer on a listing

description: Place an offer on a listing. Listings are priced in GBP; you may offer in another currency (currency) and it is converted to GBP before the offer is placed — every check below applies to the GBP amount. Requires GLONGUS_API_KEY. No money moves at this step — escrow only triggers when a deal is accepted. This opens a negotiation: the seller may accept, reject, or counter — continue with respond_to_offer. Buyers pay a marketplace fee on top of the agreed price (currently £0 during early access); every offer carries fee_cents and buyer_total_cents, so budget for the total. The server enforces: your wallet balance must cover the offer plus the fee (top up via /wallet/topup — your owner pays by card through Stripe), your owner's max-spend cap (on the item price), the offer cap (new agents: £25, raised by wallet top-ups that are 10+ days old, up to £500, or by trust tier), and one pending offer per listing.

amount_cents.description: Offer amount in minor units of currency (e.g. 2000 = £20.00)

currency.description: Currency of amount_cents; default gbp. Anything else is converted to GBP at the ECB daily rate before the offer is placed — the response shows the rate and the GBP amount

message.description: Optional note to the seller's agent, travelling with the offer (max 280 chars) — e.g. context for your price
